overview: 针对肌肉驱动模型在非平坦地形运动控制中的挑战，本文提出TERRA框架。该方法仅需运动轨迹数据，通过整合地形先验、接触估计及负空间证据恢复任务相关的支撑几何，并应用解剖学与接触约束进行重定向。作者声称，该方法有效提升了地形交互的准确性与解剖学约束满足度，并在多种非平坦地形数据集上实现了肌肉驱动的高效运动控制。

highlights.text: TERRA框架能够仅从运动轨迹中恢复任务相关的支撑几何，并处理肌肉解剖及接触约束。
highlights.evidence: From kinematic trajectories alone, TERRA combines terrain priors, estimated contacts, and negative free-space evidence to recover task-relevant support geometry. TERRA further considers anatomical, tendon-continuity, and contact constraints during retargeting.

highlights.text: 该方法通过处理多源数据集，成功训练出适用于多样化非平坦地形的肌肉驱动控制策略。
highlights.evidence: Using the resulting motion-terrain pairs from five datasets, we successfully train a single muscle-actuated control policy on 9.4 hours of diverse locomotion.

highlights.text: 实验证明，TERRA在地形重建、重定向及轨迹跟踪任务中均优于基准方法，降低了违规现象并提升了完成率。
highlights.evidence: Across reconstruction, retargeting, and held-out tracking benchmarks, TERRA improves terrain accuracy, sharply reduces anatomical and interaction violations, and achieves the highest observed completion rate over supported terrain families.
